blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines – House Minority Leader Marcelino Libanan on Sunday welcomed the creation of over 5,000 regular social worker posts to reinforce frontline operations for the government’s flagship anti-poverty Pantawid Pamilyang Pilipino Program (4Ps). In a statement, the 4Ps party-list representative said that the Department of Budget and Management’s (DBM) approval of 5,703 regular posts for 4Ps will strengthen the implementation of the conditional cash transfer program for indigent families. “For years, the 4Ps has relied heavily on temporary contract-of-service and job-order workers,” Libanan said.
